messages:
maria (partnerships): heads-up — EdgeHub + BlueArc asked to co-run a joint webinar (cloud marketplace + hardware demo angle). want to lock speakers, demo flow, and swag plan by EOD friday. anyone available for a quick sync?

sachin (eng): can do. need to know which model variant we serve on the demo cluster (fp16/qat/8-bit) — affects infra and GPU count. also: will the demo be on-hosted or on EdgeHub hardware?

jordan (solutions): EdgeHub wants an on-device demo and a cloud fallback via the AWS Marketplace listing. propose two short demos: 1) on-device low-latency Q&A, 2) marketplace quick-deploy for scale. each 8-10min. i can own runbook + demo scripts.

alyssa (marketing): timeline: promo starts next tuesday. need speaker headshots, 1-paragraph bios, and a 2-sentence hook for the landing page by monday. also: confirm recording + on-demand rights. we should decide swag tier: stickers + laptop sleeves or powerbanks?

ben (ops): swag budget approved up to $2k. powerbanks are slightly heavier for shipping internationally. laptop sleeves cheaper. we can do 200 stickers + 100 sleeves within budget. shipping lead time ~12 business days from PO.

maria (partnerships): @ben noted. @jordan please confirm exact demo infra needs so sachin can provision. @alyssa recording rights: EdgeHub legal wants to review announcment blurbs and on-demand hosting — can legal-review-bot route the joint announcement to contracts?

legal-review-bot: routing initiated. please attach the proposed announcement copy and speaker list in this thread or link to the Google Doc. ETA: 48 hours.

sachin (eng): for on-device demo we need 1x A10G-equivalent for local dev preview + 2x T4s for cloud fallback if we serve 8-bit quantized model. if we do fp16 baseline we need 2x A10G for smooth 5-10 concurrent sessions. also need a short-lived API key for marketplace demo — will set up a rotation.

jordan (solutions): runbook draft:
```
00:00 intro + partner intros (4m)
04:00 on-device demo (8m) - EdgeHub engineer live demo
12:30 marketplace deploy (10m) - quick deploy from marketplace console -> Redwood API call
23:00 Q&A (20m)
```
I'll push the runbook to the shared doc and tag folks. demo commands below (placeholder creds):
```
# marketplace demo snippet
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploy \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"model":"edge-quant-v1","region":"us-west-2"}'
```

alyssa (marketing): sounds good. rehearsal window: can we rehearse w/ partners next wednesday 10:00-11:30 PT? calendar-bot, can you try to book 60m + 30m buffer?

calendar-bot: tentative slot created: Wed 10:00-11:30 PT. invites sent to maria, sachin, jordan, alyssa, ben, EdgeHub-sme, BlueArc-sme. accept/decline by EOD tuesday.

ben (ops): swag ops note — need finalized item list by monday to hit PO timelines. recommend stickers + sleeves to avoid additional customs paperwork.

maria (partnerships): action items: jordan -> runbook + demo creds (due monday), sachin -> infra sizing + short-lived keys (due monday), alyssa -> landing page copy + speaker bios (due monday), ben -> finalize swag SKU & shipping plan (due monday), legal-review-bot -> return signoff or comments (ETA 48h). i'll follow up with EdgeHub to lock speakers. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alyssa (marketing): quick ask — can partners provide a 1-slide architecture diagram for the landing page? simple SVG/PDF. EdgeHub asked for our logo lockup guidelines too.

jordan (solutions): will request diagram from EdgeHub and attach to runbook.

maria (partnerships): perfect. if no objections i'll convert this to a tracking doc after this thread and keep weekly syncs until the event.

ben (ops): no objections.

maria (partnerships): closing loop — EdgeHub confirmed two speakers (CTO + Field eng). BlueArc confirmed an integration engineer for the on-device demo. all good on our end unless someone flags something by 5pm today.
